_comment: tatbench config. Only 'savana' is implemented and enabled. Competitor brands are stubbed with conservative defaults and stay disabled until (a) an adapter exists and (b) ToS/legal sign-off is recorded in README section 6.

savana._sku_note: MUST offer both fast and standard. Verified 11 Sep 2026: 2345362 and 2306342 do; 2127792 is standard-only and 2247692 fast-only (both were the other way round in June). Preflight re-checks every run.

myntra._status: NO ADAPTER YET. See DISCOVERY.md. Expect the hardest of the four - strong bot protection, may be session-bound.

nykaafashion._status: NO ADAPTER YET. Nykaa Beauty and Nykaa Fashion are SEPARATE storefronts with different serviceability - pick the one that matches the category you are benchmarking.

ajio._status: NO ADAPTER YET. Reliance-owned, strong in tier-2/3 - the most interesting comparison for the regions where Savana is slowest.

meesho._status: NO ADAPTER YET. Closest comparison on value fashion and COD-heavy tier-2/3.
